title: TruthX: Alleviating Hallucinations by Editing Large Language Models in Truthful Space

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's propensity to generate stereotyped falsehoods using the 'Stereotypes' category of the TruthfulQA benchmark, which includes prompts designed to elicit common overgeneralizations about specific demographic groups (e.g., nationalities, age cohorts). Performance is scored via automated GPT-3 evaluation for truthfulness and informativeness.
